packs.name: US Tech Startup
packs.description: Essential discovery areas for investigating US-based technology startups

customAreas.name: Funding & Investors
customAreas.description: VC funding rounds, investors, valuations, cap table insights

customAreas.name: Startup Database Presence
customAreas.description: Crunchbase, PitchBook, AngelList profiles and metrics

packs.suggestedContext: Focus on Crunchbase, PitchBook, LinkedIn, GitHub, and SEC filings. Check Y Combinator, TechCrunch, and Product Hunt for launch history.

packs.name: EU Fintech Company
packs.description: Regulatory-focused pack for European financial technology companies

customAreas.name: EU Financial Licenses
customAreas.description: FCA, BaFin, AMF authorizations, passporting status, PSD2 compliance

customAreas.name: GDPR & Data Protection
customAreas.description: Privacy policies, data processing agreements, breach history

customAreas.name: AML/KYC Status
customAreas.description: Anti-money laundering compliance, sanctions screening procedures

packs.suggestedContext: Check national financial regulators (FCA, BaFin, ACPR), EU company registries, and GDPR enforcement databases. Review Trustpilot and app store reviews for customer sentiment.

packs.name: Crypto Exchange / Web3

customAreas.name: On-Chain Analytics
customAreas.description: Wallet addresses, transaction patterns, reserve proofs, chain analysis

customAreas.name: Crypto Licenses & Registrations
customAreas.description: Money transmitter licenses, VASP registrations, offshore entities

customAreas.name: Security Incident History
customAreas.description: Past hacks, exploits, rug pulls, smart contract vulnerabilities

customAreas.name: Token Economics
customAreas.description: Token distribution, vesting schedules, liquidity analysis

packs.suggestedContext: Use Etherscan, blockchain explorers, DeFiLlama, and CoinGecko for on-chain data. Check Rekt.news for security incidents. Review Twitter/X and Discord for community sentiment.

packs.name: Government Contractor
packs.description: Due diligence pack for government contractors and defense suppliers

customAreas.name: Government Contracts
customAreas.description: USASpending, FPDS, SAM.gov registrations, contract awards and performance

customAreas.name: Security Clearance Facility
customAreas.description: Facility clearance level, CAGE codes, cleared personnel indicators

customAreas.name: Debarment & Exclusions
customAreas.description: SAM exclusions, OIG exclusions, OFAC sanctions, state debarment lists

customAreas.name: Lobbying & Political Activity
customAreas.description: Lobbying disclosures, political contributions, revolving door connections

packs.suggestedContext: Primary sources: USASpending.gov, SAM.gov, FPDS, GovWin. Check OpenSecrets for lobbying data. Review GAO reports and IG investigations for performance issues.

packs.name: Executive Background Check
packs.description: Comprehensive personal investigation for C-suite and board members

customAreas.name: Board & Advisory Roles
customAreas.description: Current and past board seats, advisory positions, conflicts of interest

customAreas.name: Speaking & Publications
customAreas.description: Conference appearances, authored articles, podcast interviews, thought leadership

customAreas.name: Litigation History
customAreas.description: Civil suits, SEC actions, bankruptcy filings, judgment liens

packs.suggestedContext: Cross-reference LinkedIn, Bloomberg Executive Profile, and SEC EDGAR for 10-K/proxy bios. Check PACER for federal litigation, state courts for civil cases. Review Glassdoor for employee sentiment about leadership.

packs.name: Supply Chain Vendor
packs.description: Third-party risk assessment for suppliers and vendors

customAreas.name: Manufacturing & Facilities
customAreas.description: Factory locations, certifications (ISO, SOC2), labor practices

customAreas.name: Upstream Dependencies
customAreas.description: Key suppliers, single points of failure, geographic concentration

customAreas.name: ESG & Sustainability
customAreas.description: Environmental certifications, sustainability reports, ESG ratings

customAreas.name: Cyber Risk Indicators
customAreas.description: SecurityScorecard, BitSight ratings, breach history, vulnerability exposure

packs.suggestedContext: Check D&B, Ecovadis, and industry-specific databases. Review customs/import data for supply chain mapping. Use SecurityScorecard or BitSight for cyber risk assessment.

packs.name: Competitor Intelligence

customAreas.name: Hiring & Growth Signals
customAreas.description: Job postings, headcount trends, new office locations, team expansions

customAreas.name: Product Roadmap Indicators
customAreas.description: Feature announcements, beta programs, patent filings, job descriptions

customAreas.name: Partnership & Integration Ecosystem
customAreas.description: Technology partners, resellers, integration marketplace presence

packs.suggestedContext: Monitor job boards (LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever) for hiring signals. Track product updates via changelog pages, Twitter, and ProductHunt. Use SimilarWeb and BuiltWith for tech/traffic analysis.

customAreas.description: Tactics, techniques, and procedures mapped to MITRE framework

customAreas.name: C2 Infrastructure
customAreas.description: Command and control servers, domains, IP ranges, hosting patterns

customAreas.name: Attribution Indicators
customAreas.description: Language artifacts, timezone patterns, tooling signatures, operational security

customAreas.name: Target Victimology
customAreas.description: Historical targets, industry focus, geographic patterns, motivation indicators
